alias-of:ammon_58>rabbah_966@478600.note: Deut 3:11 calls Rabbath the city of the children of Ammon; Ezek 25:5 names Rabbah and the Ammonites separately. Ammon is the people and land, not the city.

alias-of:aram-zobah_85>zobah_1272@cc0d20.note: 2 Sam 10:6 has 'the Syrians of Zoba' and 1 Sam 14:47 'the kings of Zobah'. That Aram-zobah names this same kingdom is an outside identification.

alias-of:beth-barah_194>bethany_187@6277.note: Judg 7:24 names Beth-barah at the Jordan fords; John 1:28 names Bethabara beyond Jordan. That this place is Bethany is an outside identification.

alias-of:beth-marcaboth_222>madmannah_74.note: Josh 15:31 lists Madmannah, and Josh 19:5 and 1 Chr 4:31 list Bethmarcaboth, in the same place beside Ziklag. Two spellings in parallel lists: a reading.

alias-of:bozrah_257>bozrah_256@9ca13c.note: Jer 48:24 places Bozrah in Moab, while Gen 36:33 places Jobab's Bozrah in Edom. The text describes two different Bozrahs.

alias-of:gath-rimmon_445>ibleam_589@b6b1.note: Josh 21:25 gives Gathrimmon as a Manasseh Levite city; 1 Chr 6:70 gives Bileam in the same list place. Bileam is Ibleam spelled differently; a reading.

alias-of:geba_448>geba_447@144fc1.note: Josh 21:17 names Geba among Benjamin's Levite cities; 2 Sam 5:25 names Geba with no tribe. That the two entries are one town is a reading.

alias-of:hammon_519>hammath_518@69026a.note: Hammon is in Asher's border (Josh 19:28) and a Naphtali Levite city (1 Chr 6:76); Hammath is a fenced Naphtali city (19:35). Spellings differ; a reading.

alias-of:ir-shemesh_600>beth-shemesh_234.note: Josh 19:41 names Irshemesh in Dan's lot and Josh 15:10 names Bethshemesh on Judah's border. Two spellings in two tribes make identity a reading.

alias-of:kedesh_677>kadesh-barnea_663@ee.note: Josh 15:23 lists Kedesh among Judah's southern towns and 15:3 places Kadeshbarnea on the south border. Shared name and region make identity a reading.

alias-of:ramoth_982>baalath-beer_138@2e3.note: Josh 19:8 names 'Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south' and 1 Sam 30:27 has 'Ramoth of the south'. The spelling and the apposition make this a reading.

alias-of:rephaim_995>valley_of_rephaim_1.note: Deut 3:13 calls Argob and Bashan the land of giants. 2 Sam 5:18 places the valley of Rephaim by Jerusalem. The text puts these in different places.

alias-of:rock_1011>maon_764@fdfcfb.note: 1 Sam 23:25 puts David in a rock in the wilderness of Maon; 23:28 names the place Sela-hammahlekoth. Equating that rock with the town Maon is a reading.

alias-of:telaim_1144>telem_1146@42ace3.note: 1 Sam 15:4 places Saul's muster at Telaim and Josh 15:24 lists Telem among Judah's southern towns. The spellings are close; identity is a reading.

birth:hezekiah_1512@4b0128.note: Hezekiah was 25 when he began to reign (18:2), so birth is 25 years before accession. The year depends on dating his accession outside Scripture.

death:hezekiah_1512@14f85c.note: Hezekiah reigned 29 years from age 25 (18:2). His death is not dated, so the year depends on dating his accession outside Scripture.

died-at:amram_242>egypt_362@ed08eb.note: Num 26:59 has Jochebed, Amram's wife, born in Egypt. Amram's death is not recorded, so Egypt is an inference.

died-at:azariah_381>jerusalem_636@467870.note: Jehoram slew all his brethren, including Azariah (21:2, 21:4), but the place is not named. Jerusalem is where Jehoram reigned (21:5).

died-at:jehiel_773>jerusalem_636@965982.note: Jehoram slew all his brethren, including Jehiel (21:2, 21:4), but the place is not named. Jerusalem is where Jehoram reigned (21:5).

died-at:michael_2066>jerusalem_636@40d71.note: Jehoram slew all his brethren, including Michael (21:2, 21:4), but the place is not named. Jerusalem is where Jehoram reigned (21:5).

died-at:shephatiah_2660>jerusalem_636@6f.note: Jehoram slew all his brethren, including Shephatiah (21:2, 21:4), but the place is not named. Jerusalem is where Jehoram reigned (21:5).

died-at:zechariah_3010>jerusalem_636@8db.note: Jehoram slew all his brethren, including Zechariah (21:2, 21:4), but the place is not named. Jerusalem is where Jehoram reigned (21:5).

died-at:jehoiakim_1085>jerusalem_636@f14.note: Jehoiakim reigned in Jerusalem (23:36) and 'slept with his fathers' (24:6). The text does not name the place of his death.

parent-of:jeduthun_1224>shimei_2233@0ec1.note: 25:3 says Jeduthun had six sons but names five; the sixth is not named. Shimei is in the course list (25:17). Making him the sixth is a reading.
